items: Usage opens on Last 30 days. Choose 7/30/90 calendar days or inclusive custom dates, with provider/model lines or stacked bars.
Inspect provider totals, model shares, token categories and daily records. Unknown costs and coverage remain explicit; this is not a subscription allowance or bill.

With COS server 6.92.1, clean repeated audio can receive anonymous Voice 1, Voice 2 and later labels while a Mac recording runs. Uncertain audio stays unidentified. Voice numbers are not identities, and Mac renames do not train profiles.
Windu one-session run bursts have matching cadence and a shorter raised-saber pause. A failed cast load can retry on a later refresh; healthy art is retained and custom timing/art stays yours.
The reported repeated-lineup behavior was not reproduced; the failed-load recovery test does not establish its historical cause.
